info.text:
Same $4,000 paycheck. Three budgets. Totally different rules.
50/30/20 (popularized by Elizabeth Warren and Amelia Warren Tyagi, 2005): our math is $2,000 needs, $1,200 wants, $800 saved.
Zero-based: every dollar gets a job until $0 is left. A 1970 Harvard Business Review article popularized it for companies.
Pay yourself first (The Richest Man in Babylon, 1926): our example saves 10%, $400, on payday.
A year ago, Fidelity's study (Dec 2025) found 64% considering a money resolution for 2026.
Sources: Fidelity Resolutions Study (released Dec 2025), All Your Worth (2005), Harvard Business Review (1970), The Richest Man in Babylon (1926).
News and education, not financial advice.
Follow @financeprostv for money explained simply.
